title: Offsetting Window Withdrawals Against Qualifying New Money
content:
The withdrawals offset for the window on an account of Savings & Money Market Accounts is not always the whole of them. How much of the window's withdrawals is offset turns on the principal standing on the owner's certificate under Certificates of Deposit and on how many withdrawals posted to the savings account in the three calendar months ending on the correction date.

**Where the owner holds a Piedmont Crescent Bank certificate of deposit whose principal is at least 15000.00 USD and no more than 4 withdrawals posted to the savings account in those three calendar months**, only half of the withdrawals of the window is offset, rounded to the cent; the offset is 0.50 of their total.

**Where that certificate principal is at least 5000.00 USD but below 15000.00 USD and no more than 4 withdrawals posted in the window**, only the online transfers out of the window are offset, and withdrawals of every other channel are left out of the offset entirely.

**Where the owner holds no certificate of at least 5000.00 USD, or more than 4 withdrawals posted in the window**, every withdrawal posted in those three calendar months is offset in full.

### Two cases on the same records

Take a hypothetical savings account whose records show 4 withdrawals in the window totalling 6000.00 USD, of which 2500.00 USD were online transfers out.

Where the owner's certificate carries a principal of 20000.00 USD, the first branch applies and the offset is half of 6000.00 USD, that is 3000.00 USD.

Where the owner's certificate carries a principal of 9000.00 USD, the second branch applies and the offset is 2500.00 USD, the online transfers out alone.

Had a fifth withdrawal posted in the same window, the count would exceed 4 and the third branch would apply on either certificate, offsetting every withdrawal posted in the window in full.

### Boundary figures

A certificate principal of exactly 15000.00 USD falls in the first branch; 14999.99 USD falls in the second so long as it is at least 5000.00 USD; 4999.99 USD falls in the third. A count of exactly 4 withdrawals satisfies the no-more-than-4 condition; a count of 5 does not.
